through_line: The repos that climbed this week stayed thin and stood on tools that already worked.
prior_through_lines: Agents are gaining persistent memory and self-composing skill loops between sessions. (Issue 2)
This week's breakout repos pulled AI off the cloud and onto hardware the user owns. (Issue 4)
This week's builds were connective tissue for agents, not new models. (Issue 5)
evidence_paragraph: taste-skill (@LexnLin) ships its design sense as plain SKILL.md rule files registered in a Bash lookup table, and crossed 42,647 stars on a +6,847 week. Agent-Reach (@Neo_Reidlab) is thin CLI glue over tools engineers already trust, Jina Reader, yt-dlp and gh, and added 3,397 stars. fast-agent (@evalstate) conforms to the MCP spec rather than wrapping it, shipping v0.7.16 and v0.7.17 inside one week. agentsview (@wesmckinn) is one Go binary that reads the JSONL coding agents already write, and gained 722 stars in two days. None of the four built a new abstraction; each won by standing on something that already existed.
counter_signal: cua (@francedot) went the other way, building heavyweight new sandbox infrastructure to give agents a real but isolated machine, and still held 17,874 stars.
